scope: development-only review of frozen production snapshot

evidence: G22 production artifacts certify session 2026-09-20 while gate/work-state files in the frozen head still describe G11 blocked.
findings.risk: A developer may reopen old gates or apply incorrect regression assumptions.
findings.correction: Treat G22 artifacts + immutable handoff as production baseline; record state drift explicitly and avoid rewriting historical certification files in development.

evidence: Legacy MAIN APP/cascade/history workflows still execute around G22.
